headline: Real wallet and consensus treasury fee are live — mainnet is in launch phase.
summary: The public site, waitlist, and miner portal are fully deployed on production with HTTPS. The real Windows wallet installer (release candidate) is published with a verified checksum, and the 2% consensus treasury fee is implemented and verified. Remaining before the mainnet block-1 launch: Windows code-signing, the production pool cutover, and rendering our own how-to videos to replace the interim placeholders.
